headline: A Press Secretary like none other
dek: The head of the UFC is offered the White House podium, with champion fighters as assistants, to defend the administration against the Lunatic Left.

original.speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: I am pleased to announce that the Great Dana White, a violent Fighter and Warrior, has been offered the job of Press Secretary of the United States. I have requested that he bring with him assistants, even though some are not from our Country, of Islam Makhachev, Khabib Nurmagomedov, Justin Gaethje, Daniel Cormier, Amanda Nunes, and Kayla Harris. We need these people to defend us against the Lunatic Left. Dana will be a Press Secretary like none other. Dana, please take the job! President DONALD J. TRUMP

verification.note: Copied by the editor from truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump on 7 November 2026. Time approximate: shown as “4h” ago at about 6:35 PM ET; posted just before the post on donors.

en: I have offered the position of White House Press Secretary to Dana White, who built one of the most successful sports organizations in the world. I admire his energy and his directness.
The Press Secretary’s job is to inform the American people and to answer the press, including its hardest questions. I am confident Dana would bring candor to that podium, and I hope he will accept.
fr: J’ai proposé le poste de porte-parole de la Maison-Blanche à Dana White, qui a bâti l’une des organisations sportives les plus prospères au monde. J’admire son énergie et sa franchise.

Le rôle du porte-parole est d’informer les Américains et de répondre à la presse, y compris à ses questions les plus difficiles. Je suis convaincu que Dana apporterait de la franchise à cette tribune, et j’espère qu’il acceptera.

text: Adieu ! J’ai proposé à Dana White d’être mon porte-parole. Un vrai lutteur ! Et je lui ai demandé de venir avec quelques champions, même des étrangers, pour nous défendre contre les gens d’en bas.

Chez nous, on a les combats de reines : des vaches d’Hérens qui se poussent front contre front, personne ne se blesse, et la gagnante monte la première à l’alpage. Dana, c’est ma reine. Dana, viens, la place est à toi !
en: Hello! I’ve asked Dana White to be my press secretary. A real fighter! And I’ve asked him to bring a few champions, even foreign ones, to defend us against the lowlanders.
Up here we have cow fights: Hérens cows pushing head to head, nobody gets hurt, and the winner leads the herd up to the summer pasture. Dana is my queen. Dana, come on, the job is yours!
notes: The “combats de reines” of Valais are traditional, bloodless contests between Hérens cows; the winner is crowned queen of the herd.

text: Écoutez, j’ai proposé le poste de porte-parole à Dana White, avec une petite délégation internationale de champions de combat pour l’accompagner.

À Genève, on reçoit des délégations étrangères toute l’année, mais d’habitude elles viennent négocier la paix. La mienne viendra tenir la salle de presse. Ce sera un porte-parole comme on n’en a jamais vu au bord du lac. Dana, accepte, on t’offre le café à six francs cinquante.
en: Listen, I’ve offered the press secretary job to Dana White, with a small international delegation of fighting champions to go with him.

In Geneva we host foreign delegations all year round, but usually they come to negotiate peace. Mine will come to hold the press room. A press secretary like none ever seen by the lake. Dana, accept, and the seven-dollar coffee is on us.

text: J’ai proposé le poste de porte-parole à Dana White, un vrai combattant, avec des champions du monde entier comme assistants. Contre la gauche, il faut ce qu’il faut.

Chez vous, le porte-parole esquive les questions avec des phrases ; le mien les esquivera avec un crochet du gauche. C’est plus franc. Dana, prends le job, je t’en supplie. Enfin, je te le demande. Fermement.
en: I’ve offered the press secretary job to Dana White, a real fighter, with champions from all over the world as his assistants. Against the left, you need what you need.
Your spokesmen dodge questions with long sentences; mine will dodge them with a left hook. It’s more honest. Dana, take the job, I’m begging you. Well, I’m asking. Firmly.

text: Oh, je vous annonce une nouvelle extraordinaire, la plus extraordinaire de l’histoire : Dana White, porte-parole ! Un guerrier ! Et avec lui, des champions du Brésil, du Daghestan, de partout ! Contre les fadas de gauche, il faut ça.
À Marseille, on appellerait ça le Vélodrome un soir de Marseille-Paris. Dana, viens, on t’attend, et on t’a gardé la meilleure place à l’ombre du platane !
en: Oh, I’m announcing extraordinary news, the most extraordinary in history: Dana White, press secretary! A warrior! And with him, champions from Brazil, from Dagestan, from everywhere! Against the lunatics on the left, that’s what it takes.
In Marseille we’d call that the stadium on a Marseille–Paris match night. Dana, come, we’re waiting for you, and we’ve kept you the best seat in the shade of the plane tree!
notes: The Vélodrome is Marseille’s football stadium; matches against Paris Saint-Germain are the most heated of the French season.

text: Salut les gaillards ! J’ai proposé à Dana White d’être mon porte-parole. Un lutteur, un vrai, avec toute une équipe de champions, même des étrangers.

Chez nous, on connaît : la lutte suisse, dans la sciure. Et à la fin, le vainqueur aide le perdant à se relever et lui enlève la sciure du dos. Je ne sais pas si Dana fera ça avec les journalistes. Mais bon, Dana, prends le job, ça joue !
en: Hey folks! I’ve asked Dana White to be my press secretary. A wrestler, a real one, with a whole team of champions, even foreign ones.

We know all about it here: Swiss wrestling, in sawdust. And at the end, the winner helps the loser up and brushes the sawdust off his back. Not sure Dana will do that with the journalists. Still, Dana, take the job, it’s all good!
notes: In Schwingen, Swiss wrestling, the winner traditionally brushes the sawdust off the loser’s back after the bout.

text: Les gones, j’ai proposé à Dana White de devenir mon porte-parole, avec des champions de combat comme assistants.

À Lyon, la formule existe déjà : ça s’appelle Guignol. Depuis deux siècles, il tape sur le gendarme avec son bâton, et tout le monde rit. Dana sera un porte-parole comme on n’en a jamais vu. Dana, accepte, et viens manger au bouchon.
en: Guys, I’ve asked Dana White to become my press secretary, with fighting champions as his assistants.

In Lyon the formula already exists: it’s called Guignol. For two centuries he’s been whacking the policeman with his stick, and everyone laughs. Dana will be a press secretary like no other. Dana, accept, and come and eat at the bistro.
notes: Guignol, the glove puppet created in Lyon in the early 1800s, is famous for whacking the gendarme with his stick.

text: Well, I’ve offered the press secretary job to Dana White, a real fighter, a warrior. And I’ve asked him to bring a few champions along, some of them not from around here, because we need folks who can handle the Lunatic Left.
In Texas, we’d call that a town hall meeting. Dana, it’s a big job in a big country. Saddle up and take it!
en: He has offered the job to a fight promoter, with champions as backup, against the “Lunatic Left”.
In Texas, a press room full of fighters sounds like a normal town meeting; he wants Dana to “saddle up” and accept.

text: I offered Dana White the press secretary job. Fighter, warrior, the whole deal. He’s bringing a few champions too, some from overseas, don’t care.
You want to handle the press in this country? Kid, I’ve been in the room after the Red Sox lose to the Yankees. Dana, take the job. And bring more guys.
en: He has offered the job to Dana White and his fighters, and doesn’t care where they come from.
As a Bostonian, he knows sports press conferences can be brutal, so Dana had better bring backup.
fr: The Boston Red Sox and the New York Yankees have one of the oldest and fiercest rivalries in American sport.
notes: The Boston Red Sox and the New York Yankees have one of the oldest and fiercest rivalries in American sport.

text: I’ve offered Dana White the press secretary job, lad. Proper fighter. Told him to bring his mates, a few of them not from round here, to sort out the Lunatic Left.
A press office full of fighters? Sounds like a Saturday night in town. Dana, go ’ed, take the job. And bring Khabib round ours for a brew.
en: He’s hired a real fighter as press secretary, with his mates as backup.
In Liverpool, a room full of fighters just sounds like a night out; he invites them all over for a cup of tea.
fr: In British English, a “brew” is a cup of tea, which suits Khabib Nurmagomedov, who does not drink alcohol.
notes: “Go ’ed” means go ahead in Scouse, Liverpool’s English; a “brew” is a cup of tea, which suits Khabib Nurmagomedov, who does not drink alcohol.

text: We note with interest the President’s choice of Mr White, whose experience in managing robust exchanges of views is beyond question. The briefing room can indeed be a lively place.
We would simply observe that, in our tradition, a spokesman’s most effective defence remains the phrase “I couldn’t possibly comment.”
en: He is hiring a fight boss to deal with journalists.
We prefer to dodge questions politely. It hurts less.

text: France has always welcomed great champions, including those who come from abroad, and we warmly congratulate Mr White.
We confess to some surprise, however. In the French tradition, a government spokesperson defends the government with words, sometimes a great many words, but rarely with a submission hold.
fr: La France a toujours accueilli les grands champions, y compris ceux venus de l’étranger, et nous adressons nos chaleureuses félicitations à M. White.

Nous avouons toutefois une certaine surprise. Dans la tradition française, le porte-parole du gouvernement défend le gouvernement avec des mots, parfois beaucoup de mots, mais rarement avec une clé de bras.

text: The Federal Council takes note of this appointment and wishes Mr White every success in his new duties.

In Switzerland, the Federal Council’s spokesperson is the Vice-Chancellor, and our press conferences rarely require more protection than a glass of water. We remain at the disposal of all parties, should they ever wish to continue the debate in a quieter setting.
fr: Le Conseil fédéral prend acte de cette nomination et souhaite plein succès à M. White dans ses nouvelles fonctions.

En Suisse, le porte-parole du Conseil fédéral est le vice-chancelier, et nos conférences de presse exigent rarement une autre protection qu’un verre d’eau. Nous restons à la disposition de toutes les parties, si elles souhaitaient un jour poursuivre le débat dans un cadre plus calme.
notes: The spokesperson of the Swiss Federal Council is one of the two Vice-Chancellors of the Federal Chancellery.
